description: Mokosz, the old Slavic mother goddess of the earth, spinning and the harvest, a dignified calm woman of middle age with long dark braided hair under a white embroidered linen headscarf, a wreath of golden wheat ears and red poppies, a red and white embroidered linen dress, holding a wooden distaff with a bundle of pale flax, golden wheat sheaves at her shoulder, head and shoulders portrait, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, slavic pagan mythology, dignified, muted natural colours
